# Focus25

> Free, minimal Pomodoro timer — no signup, no ads, instant focus.

Focus25 is a web-based productivity tool that implements the Pomodoro Technique. Users start a 25-minute focus timer with one click, take short breaks, and track completed sessions — all without creating an account.

## Features

- One-click Pomodoro timer (25 min focus / 5 min break)
- Customizable durations (5, 10, 15, 25 minutes)
- Ambient background sounds (rain, café, lo-fi, nature)
- Session tracking and daily statistics
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers
- No signup or login required
- Completely free

## Supported Languages

English, Italian, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Tagalog (Filipino)

## URLs

- Homepage: https://focus25.io
- Pomodoro Timer: https://focus25.io/pomodoro-timer
- Focus Timer: https://focus25.io/focus-timer
- Study Timer: https://focus25.io/study-timer
- Blog: https://focus25.io/blog

## Use Cases

- Students studying for exams
- Remote workers managing deep work blocks
- Writers and creatives maintaining focus
- Anyone looking to reduce distractions and improve productivity

## Technical Details

- Client-side web application (React + TypeScript)
- No backend or user data collection
- Works offline after initial load
- Progressive Web App compatible
